There’s a Nurtec for that!

Migraine care is complicated and individualized – NURTEC ODT is a flexible therapy that may be an appropriate treatment for a vast number of patients within an HCP’s practice.

This module briefly reviews one of the five Patient Profiles featured in the Nurtec HCP DSP, to illustrate how this information can help your customer relate the data around NURTEC ODT to the patients they see in their daily practice.

Meet Jenny

I’m a 36-year-old artist. I’m seeking additional treatment options to help meet my treatment goals.
Migraine History
  • 2-4 monthly migraine days
  • Symptoms: photophobia, phonophobia
Needs
  • A treatment that she can tolerate and allows her to take at the first sign of migraine pain
  • Fast relief and return to normal function, with a lasting response
Comorbidities

Depression and anxiety, managed with treatment

Medications
  • Acute: OTC medications, previously tried 2 different triptans
  • Preventive: None

Why Nurtec ODT may be right for Jenny…

Acute pivotal trial:Patients experienced rapid and sustained pain relief and return to normal function, including results as early as 1 hour. Safety was also evaluated.

Studied in Patients unsuitable for triptans:In these patients Nurtec was studied for pain relief at 2 hours postdose, return to normal function, sustained response and safety.

Long-term safety study:The safety profile of Nurtec ODT was studied across the acute clinical trial program, including in an open-label, 52-week study.
